source_units: QuickSearchExt is a Safari extension for searching selected text on your favorite sites from iPhone, iPad, or Mac. Use the popup on mobile or the toolbar and right-click menu on Mac for
How to use on iPhone / iPad
Tap the site you want to search.
Tip: the query auto-fills with selected text. If nothing is selected, it keeps your previous query.
Click the toolbar button, or right-click selected text →
You can run the same search sites list on both platforms.
QuickSearchExt on macOS: toolbar button and grid popup
macOS: toolbar popup with your search sites.
QuickSearchExt on iPhone: extension popup with search sites
iPhone: run searches from the Extensions popup.
QuickSearchExt on iPhone: configure search sites
Configure sites: add a name and a URL template.
with selected text; if nothing is selected, keep the previous query.
(examples): Search, Images, Maps, Video, Shopping, Encyclopedia, and more.
Reorder / enable / disable with one click.
QuickSearchExt settings on macOS: configure search sites list
macOS: edit the site list, reorder, and set defaults.
